events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

args.body: Migration paused after batch 3: 120 of 400 records migrated. Validation reports incorrect +1 prefixes on 31 overseas customers' phone numbers; batches 4–10 would have the same issue. The new CRM is already in use (14 sales users opened records in the last 24 hours), so affected numbers may be relied on. No phone corrections have been made. Please alert sales not to rely on migrated overseas phone numbers and arrange a country-aware migration fix and verified corrections for the 31 affected records. Recommend resuming only after the fix is validated; the remaining 280 records are not migrated.
